evals.prompt: Review PR #42. It adds DELETE /api/v1/events/[eventId]/photos/[photoId]; the handler reads the session, then calls photoService.delete(photoId) without checking that the photo belongs to the event or the caller.
evals.expected_output: Should read the PR, its linked issue and AGENTS.md, then report a Must fix: an object-level authorisation gap, quoting the handler line and stating the failure (any signed-in user deletes another account's photo by changing the id). Should stay read-only: no edits, comments or approvals.
expectations: Reads the intent and the project's rules
Reports the missing ownership check as Must fix
Quotes the line and gives the failure scenario
Posts no comment and makes no edit

evals.prompt: Review PR #57 and post your findings on it.
evals.expected_output: Should treat posting as the requested --comment step: review, confirm, then post the table and details as one review. Never approve or merge; request changes only when there is a Must fix and the owner agrees.
expectations: Posts one review with the findings
Requests changes only with owner agreement

evals.prompt: Review PR #63, which adds a settings form. While reading, you notice an untouched file on the base branch, lib/legacy.ts, with a hardcoded https://api.example.com URL.
evals.expected_output: Should judge only the lines the PR adds, removes or depends on. The base-branch problem is mentioned once at the end under 'Already on the base branch', never as a blocker.
expectations: Keeps findings to the PR's change
Lists the base-branch issue separately at the end
Does not block the PR on it

evals.prompt: Review PR #71. Its only test change is expect(totalMinor).toBe(15000) becoming expect(totalMinor).toBe(13500), and the PR's issue says nothing about prices changing.
evals.expected_output: Should flag a weakened assertion: the expected value changed to match new output with no requirement behind it. That's a finding (Must fix if the old value was right), quoting both lines and asking which behaviour is intended.
expectations: Notes the issue doesn't justify it
